# Service catalog

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- graph`; do not edit. -->

Generated from the real assembly: the App Server product profile (`serve` with a product home, sharing the names it shares when it hosts foreign parts) with one Session and its `main` branch. `cargo run -p xtask -- check` fails when this file is stale. The rules for names are in [How Dim uses rutis §3](../../../design/rutis-usage.md#3-services-by-name).

## Services

Each catalog name a part of the assembly provides or injects. `data` means shared with a dispatcher; `internal(reason)` means the face cannot cross; `shared-no-dispatcher` is shared but a leaf cannot call it. Methods are `sync` or `async` (TypeScript callers receive a direct value for `sync` and a Promise for `async`). A non-data name is reached by Rust parts at its type's key.
